population.title: Population 1 January by region, sex and age

acquisition_requirements: Use Statistics Denmark / StatBank output for the five region rows only.
Verify the StatBank area code for each region against the canonical subdivision ID before promotion.
Capture retrieval timestamp and exact query/export representation.
Do not use population projections in place of observed BEFOLK3 population.
Do not calculate area from simplified display geometry; use ARE207.
If population density is shown, derive it from the sourced BEFOLK3 population and ARE207 area and label it derived.

importer.rule: A real sidecar may not be generated from name-only matching; verified StatBank geography codes are required.
